design_summary: Hierarchical active-aerodynamics controller for 20-55 m/s operation with firmware-visible MMIO/CSR control, SRAM-backed sample history, external model request/response transport to a DoMINO-based surrogate, transparent reference validation, safety gating, stale-data detection, timeout handling, and bounded actuator-command generation. Invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions inhibit actuator validity and latch faults; no fallback command is created.

fixed_assumptions: Operating speed window is firmware-configurable with documented safe defaults spanning 20 m/s to 55 m/s.
The control plane is MMIO/CSR-based and writable registers are exposed through the top-level bus.
Bulk sample history is stored in a technology-neutral SRAM wrapper/macro and not flattened into registers.

feature_contracts.description: Firmware can write control and limit registers and observe readback through the MMIO/CSR interface.
When a qualified sample is available, the surrogate adapter drives a model request outward with valid and data while consuming request ready from the external model service.
A valid surrogate response matched to a valid reference allows actuator command validity to assert when the actuator is ready and all safety conditions are satisfied.
If the sample age exceeds the configured stale threshold, the safety path inhibits actuator validity and latches fault status.
If a model response does not arrive before the configured timeout, the controller inhibits actuation and latches a fault.
If surrogate output exceeds the transparent reference residual limit, the controller suppresses valid actuation and latches a fault.

top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level integration of firmware MMIO/CSR, sensor ingest/history, external model transport, transparent reference model, and final safety arbitration. The top exposes real actuator outputs, real firmware-visible MMIO/CSR transport, and real model request/response transport in the mandated directions. It instantiates the memory macro for bulk history storage and never creates a fallback command path.
top_module.functionality: Integrates firmware control, sensor ingest, SRAM-backed history, transparent reference modeling, NVIDIA DoMINO surrogate transport, and final safety arbitration. The top fans out clock/reset, decodes MMIO configuration, accepts sensor samples, stores bulk history in the SRAM macro, emits model requests with valid/data as outputs, receives model responses with valid/data as inputs, asserts model response ready as an output, computes a transparent reference, compares reference and surrogate outputs, and produces bounded actuator commands only when data are fresh, configured limits are satisfied, and validation passes. On invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault conditions the top deasserts actuator_cmd_valid and latches a fault for software handling. No fallback command or substitute command is ever created.
responsibilities: Fan out clock and reset to all synchronous child blocks and the memory macro.
Accept and qualify sensor ingress data.
Maintain bulk history in SRAM through explicit memory interface signals.
Decode and expose firmware-visible configuration and status via MMIO/CSR.
Generate model requests and consume model responses using the mandatory transport direction contract.
Provide a transparent reference for residual checking and safety validation.
Authorize only bounded actuator commands and suppress validity on invalid conditions.
Latch faults until firmware clears them through the documented MMIO control path.
Never create a fallback command, substitute command, or fallback-on-reset behavior.
top_module.reset_behavior: On reset, all child modules and the memory interface return to safe idle defaults, actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted, model_req_valid is deasserted, model_rsp_ready is driven to a safe default, MMIO status is cleared to documented safe values, and faults are cleared only to the reset baseline defined by the contract. No actuator fallback command is produced during or after reset.
behavior_rules: All actuator outputs are only meaningful when actuator_cmd_valid is asserted.
The model-request direction is fixed: valid/data are outputs; ready is input.
The model-response direction is fixed: valid/data are inputs; ready is output.
Bulk history resides in the declared memory macro and is not flattened into registers.
MMIO writes update only implemented registers and fields; reads return implemented register or status snapshots.
On stale data, timeout, invalid model response, or residual violation, the design inhibits actuator validity and latches a fault.
No fallback command, substitute command, fallback register, or fallback-on-reset behavior is permitted.

modules.name: aero_mmio_csr
modules.description: Firmware-visible MMIO/CSR block that decodes host transactions, exposes control and limit registers, returns status/fault snapshots, and generates explicit semantic configuration signals for the controller. Every declared register is reachable through the RTL decode path.
modules.functionality: Implements the firmware-visible control plane. Decodes MMIO transactions into explicit configuration outputs, captures status snapshots from the safety path, and supports a documented clear-fault request. No inaccessible internal state is presented as software-visible unless it is reachable through MMIO decode. The block does not create or imply any fallback control behavior.
responsibilities: Decode MMIO transactions into explicit configuration and clear-control signals.
Expose configuration registers for enable, operating window, residual tolerance, timeout, freshness threshold, deflection limit, rate limit, and mode selection.
Return status and fault snapshots to software.
Provide deterministic ready/error semantics for supported and unsupported transactions.
Generate a one-cycle or level-encoded clear-fault request as documented by the register contract.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, all writable configuration registers return to safe defaults, mmio_ready is deasserted until the interface can accept a transaction, mmio_error is deasserted, and cfg_clear_faults is low. Only implemented registers are software-visible.
behavior_rules: Every declared register field is reachable through the MMIO decode path.
Writes to unimplemented addresses assert mmio_error and do not modify implemented state.
Reads from implemented addresses return the current register or status snapshot.
The clear-fault request does not generate any actuator fallback behavior.
Semantic configuration outputs are driven only by this module and consumed explicitly by downstream logic.

modules.name: sensor_ingest_and_history
modules.description: Samples and qualifies flight/airflow sensor data, maintains timestamped history entries, detects stale sample age, and exchanges bulk history with the SRAM macro. It also prepares an explicit normalized sample bundle for downstream inference and reference paths.
modules.functionality: Own technology-neutral synthesizable bulk storage implemented as an inferred memory suitable for native FPGA block RAM mapping. Its declared functional ports are the complete storage interface.
responsibilities: Gate acceptance of incoming sensor samples.
Produce an explicit sample bundle for inference and reference evaluation.
Detect stale data relative to the configured threshold.
Assert sensor_ready only when the ingest pipeline can accept a new sample.
Implement bulk storage as an inferred memory rather than a flattened bank of scalar registers.
Return stored read data through the declared functional output port.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, hold the declared read-data output benign without clearing stored memory contents. No alternate or flattened scalar-register storage is created.
behavior_rules: A new sample is accepted only when sensor_valid and sensor_ready are both asserted.
Every accepted sample updates the history path and the explicit sample bundle outputs.
If the age of the latest accepted sample exceeds cfg_stale_threshold_cycles, sample_stale asserts.
The memory dout is used for history maintenance and readback only.
This module does not alter actuator state or implement fallback control.
Infer one synthesizable unpacked memory array with synchronous access so FPGA tools can map it to block RAM.

modules.name: domino_surrogate_adapter
modules.description: Streaming transport adapter for the NVIDIA DoMINO-based surrogate. It packages normalized flight features into a model request, obeys the mandatory request/response direction contract, accepts model responses, and forwards response data and validity to the validation path.
modules.functionality: Implements the external model transport wrapper for a DoMINO-based surrogate path. It drives model request valid and data, consumes request ready, consumes response valid and data, and drives model response ready. It converts valid responses into explicit surrogate outputs for validation. The adapter does not assert actuator outputs directly and does not create fallback commands.
responsibilities: Package sample bundles into deterministic model request payloads.
Drive the request channel valid/data outward and obey ready from the external model service.
Consume response valid/data inward and provide normalized surrogate outputs.
Assert model_rsp_ready according to downstream acceptance policy.
Provide explicit surrogate outputs for validation and bounded-command synthesis.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, request valid is deasserted, response ready is driven to the safe default for the chosen transport policy, and surrogate outputs are invalid until a new response is accepted. No fallback or substitute command is generated.
behavior_rules: The request side follows the mandatory direction contract: valid/data are outputs; ready is input.
The response side follows the mandatory direction contract: valid/data are inputs; ready is output.
Only explicit sample bundles may be transformed into a request payload.
A model response is considered valid only when model_rsp_valid is asserted and the adapter is prepared to accept it.
The adapter never directly drives actuator pins and never fabricates a fallback surrogate output.
Surrogate outputs are passed to validation only after a response is received.

modules.name: reference_aero_model
modules.description: Transparent, deterministic reference path that computes expected aerodynamic command targets and bounded limits from the current sample bundle and configuration. It provides a reference against which the surrogate response is validated.
modules.functionality: Computes a transparent reference command and safety envelope from the measured flight state and current configuration. The outputs provide the deterministic baseline used for residual checking, speed-window checking, and bounded actuation. The block does not drive actuation directly and does not implement any fallback behavior.
responsibilities: Provide a transparent reference command for validation.
Publish a reference validity indication tied to the enabled operating window.
Expose a reference mode and limit-violation flag for safety checking.
Honor configured output limits and speed range constraints.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, the reference outputs are invalid and quiescent until a valid sample is presented. The block does not emit any fallback output.
behavior_rules: The reference model is transparent and deterministic for a given input sample and configuration.
reference_valid requires both cfg_enable and sample_bundle_valid to be asserted.
reference_limit_violation asserts when the computed reference exceeds configured bounds.
The reference outputs are used only for validation and bounded command synthesis.
No actuator output is ever driven directly by this block.

modules.name: command_validator_and_safety
modules.description: Validates the surrogate against the transparent reference, checks freshness and timeout conditions, and authorizes bounded actuator commands only when all conditions are satisfied. It latches faults on invalid, stale, timeout, or residual-exceed events and never synthesizes a fallback command.
modules.functionality: Performs final validation and safety arbitration. It compares surrogate output against the transparent reference, enforces residual and envelope limits, checks that samples are fresh and model responses are timely, and authorizes only bounded actuator commands that match the allowed operating region. Any invalid, stale, timeout, reset, or fault condition suppresses actuator_cmd_valid and latches the fault. No fallback command is created or substituted. Status outputs provide firmware-readable indication of busy/valid timing and last-command snapshots.
responsibilities: Compare surrogate outputs to reference outputs.
Enforce residual, speed-window, timeout, and stale-data constraints.
Produce bounded actuator command outputs only when all safety checks pass.
Latch faults and expose a fault code for software handling.
Provide busy/valid status and last command telemetry to MMIO.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, actuator_cmd_valid is deasserted, status outputs are cleared to safe defaults, and latched faults return to the documented reset state. The block never issues a substitute or fallback command on reset or on any subsequent invalid condition.
behavior_rules: A command may be issued only when cfg_enable is set and all validation checks pass.
If sample_stale is asserted, actuator_cmd_valid must be deasserted.
If model response timing exceeds cfg_timeout_cycles, the condition is latched as a fault and actuation is inhibited.
If the residual between surrogate and reference exceeds cfg_residual_limit, the condition is latched as a fault and actuation is inhibited.
actuator_cmd_deflection and actuator_cmd_rate_limit are bounded by the configured limits before actuator_cmd_valid can be asserted.
No fallback or substitute command is permitted; suppression of validity is the only permitted safe reaction.
cfg_clear_faults clears latched faults only when software explicitly requests it.

modules.name: openram_sram_128x128
modules.description: Memory macro interface module derived from memory_macros.
modules.functionality: Own technology-neutral synthesizable bulk storage implemented as an inferred memory suitable for native FPGA block RAM mapping. Its declared functional ports are the complete storage interface.
responsibilities: Implement bulk storage as an inferred memory rather than a flattened bank of scalar registers.
Return stored read data through the declared functional output port.
modules.reset_behavior: On reset, hold the declared read-data output benign without clearing stored memory contents. No alternate or flattened scalar-register storage is created.
behavior_rules: Infer one synthesizable unpacked memory array with synchronous access so FPGA tools can map it to block RAM.

top_level_connections.description: Shared synchronous clock distributed to the MMIO/CSR block, sensor ingest/history, surrogate adapter, reference model, and safety arbiter.
Shared active-low reset distributed to all submodules.
Downstream actuator handshake backpressure input into the safety arbiter.
Firmware address bus into the MMIO/CSR block.
Firmware write data bus into the MMIO/CSR block.
Firmware write enable into the MMIO/CSR block.
Firmware transaction valid into the MMIO/CSR block.
External model service ready input into the surrogate adapter.
External model service response-valid input into the surrogate adapter.
External model service response-data input into the surrogate adapter.
